commandcode-copilot.config.title: Command Code Go
commandcode-copilot.config.maxTokens.des: Output-token cap. 0 uses as much as the Generate API accepts, which is 200000 — larger values are refused with `400 Too big`. The picker is told the same figure that gets sent, so the two never disagree.
commandcode-copilot.config.zdr.descripti: Send `x-cmd-zdr: 1` on every request to enforce zero-data-retention routing. Requests only go through ZDR-capable upstreams; if a model has no ZDR upstream the request fails with HTTP 422 (`cmd_zdr_no_providers`). Disable if you hit unexpected 422s.
commandcode-copilot.config.apiKey.descri: Command Code API key (fallback). Stored values in VS Code SecretStorage take precedence; this setting is mainly for CI/automation.
commandcode-copilot.config.debugMode.des:
Controls what diagnostic information the extension writes to the output channel.

- **Minimal** — no logs beyond the activation banner.
- **Metadata** — request/response metadata (model id, message counts, tool counts, thinking effort).
- **Verbose** — full request payloads including prompts and tool schemas. May contain sensitive content.
commandcode-copilot.config.debugMode.min: No logs beyond the activation banner.
commandcode-copilot.config.debugMode.met: Request/response metadata (model id, message counts, tool counts, thinking effort).
commandcode-copilot.config.debugMode.ver: Full request payloads. May contain sensitive content.
commandcode-copilot.config.catalogBaseUr: API catalog consulted only to resolve model ids the supported sources missed. Note that the Provider API is documented as unavailable on the Go plan: its request endpoints answer `403 Your Go plan doesn't include API access`, and only this model-list endpoint is reachable. It is therefore a last resort, and the extension works without it.
commandcode-copilot.config.modelSource.d:
How the Copilot Chat model picker is populated.

- **Dynamic** — build the list from the Command Code Go plan page. New models appear as soon as the page lists them.
- **Static** — only the curated registry compiled into the extension. No network requests are made.
Models come from the live catalog endpoint; nothing is hardcoded.
commandcode-copilot.config.modelSource.s: Only the built-in registry. The catalog endpoint is never queried.
commandcode-copilot.config.modelBlacklis: Model ids to hide from the picker. Applied after catalog discovery and availability checks.
commandcode-copilot.config.maxContextTok: Override every model's reported input window; 0 keeps each model's own figure. Input and output budgets always sum to the model's real window, so a smaller input window leaves more room for output and vice versa.
commandcode-copilot.config.generateBaseU: Base URL of the Generate API that serves chat requests and availability probes. This is deliberately separate from `catalogBaseUrl`: the catalog surface serves `GET /models` only, while requests must go to the Generate surface. Point it at a proxy to route traffic through your own infrastructure.
commandcode-copilot.config.catalogRefres: Minutes before the stored model list is refetched from the plan page. This is what keeps the picker current without an extension update: the list is refreshed on first run and then whenever the stored copy is older than this. Queries inside the window are served from storage and make no requests. The plan page does not require an API key.
commandcode-copilot.config.planBaseUrl.d: Base URL of the plan documentation pages. This page decides which models the picker offers and supplies each model's capabilities, per-token pricing, intelligence score and context window. The plan slug itself is fixed to `go`. If it cannot be read, the picker replays the last known list.
commandcode-copilot.config.cliReferenceB: Base URL of the Command Code CLI reference pages. Their model table is where this extension reads canonical model ids (`moonshotai/Kimi-K3`) on the Go plan, because the API catalog that also serves ids is documented as unavailable to Go subscribers. Only change this to read a mirror or a fork of the docs.
